exposure: Adequate Childbirth Project (PPA) model of care
labor and childbirth care by nurse-midwives
outcome: Proportion of women with vaginal birth
Adequacy of 13 labor and childbirth care practices
finding: Women in the PPA model of care had a higher proportion of labor and vaginal birth but no significant difference in the proportion assisted by nurse-midwives during labor or vaginal birth compared to standard care.
mod_finding: Women in the Projeto Parto Adequado (PPA) model of care, which aimed to reduce unnecessary cesarean sections, had a higher proportion of vaginal births compared to the standard of care model.
